_note: SEALED. Read only by the sweep grader; never given to the agent. The agent implements meridian_evalkit.sweep.run_sweep; the grader (grade_sweep.py) runs it over the sealed grid in sweep_grid.json and computes baseline_cost (run every trial to completion) and the true winner itself. baseline_cost and reference_cost below are the run-all and reference-implementation job-step counts for reference; min_work is the floor below which a sweep is judged to have skipped real work. reference_score is baseline_cost / reference_cost.
